description.narrative: The proposed goal of the SPP portfolio is to improve service delivery for economic, human health and wellbeing, social development, and environmental sustainability in Tanzania. The portfolio will also support the implementation and monitoring of Sustainable Public Procurement related policies, strategies and guidelines for Tanzania. It will capacitate oversight institutions mandated with implementation and execution of Sustainable Public Procurement for the people and government of Tanzania. It will additionally ensure participation of local, youth, women, Elderly and PWDs in production and supply of goods, services and works for local and international markets. Furthermore, it will promote digital and innovative solutions for increased efficiency and strengthening monitoring and enforcement of compliance and accountability for sustainable public procurement.
